name: anim_jyu_rise
subject: a huge, heavy bear man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream splotches and a big round belly
desc: A flat brown paint puddle slowly and stickily rises: the middle bulges up into a lump, thick viscous paint stretches upward with sticky strands, the lump swells into a faceless paint humanoid, the arms peel away from the sides and droop down, everything sagging and dripping heavily. No face, no ears, the head is just a smooth dripping blob.
